name: Default
shortDescription: Live TV channel server that builds scheduled channels from your Plex media and serves them as an emulated HDHomeRun tuner and an M3U playlist with XMLTV guide data.

alerts.message: dizqueTV has no login of its own, so the template puts the web UI behind HTTP basic auth: sign in as admin with DIZQUETV_PASSWORD from the environment variables. The tuner, M3U, XMLTV and stream URLs stay public so media servers and IPTV players can reach them.
The XMLTV guide embeds your Plex address and token in program images unless image caching is on. Enable it under Settings > XMLTV before sharing the guide URL.
A Plex Media Server reachable from this server is required. Add it under Settings > Plex after the first start.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
